risks.risk: Keys or buttons may be unresponsive or sticky despite claim.
risks.proof: A video panning across the keyboard while pressing each key and demonstrating a few buttons/functions.
risks.if_unproven: priced as if some keys/buttons are non-functional (worst case).

risks.risk: Speakers may crackle or have dead channels.
risks.proof: A short audio/video clip playing a demo song through the built-in speakers.
risks.if_unproven: priced as if audio is faulty.

risks.risk: Adapter may not be the original/compatible one, or may be missing despite claim.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the adapter with model/voltage label, plugged into the unit.
risks.if_unproven: priced as if no adapter is included.

risks.risk: Yellowed keys may indicate heavy sun/heat exposure, which can also affect internal electronics.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all keys and the internal vents/casing for discoloration or heat damage.
risks.if_unproven: priced as heavily used, not 'neatly used' as claimed.

risks.risk: Model/version unknown, which affects feature set and value (e.g., touch-sensitivity, voice count, UK vs NG voltage compatibility).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model label, usually on the back or near the display.
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lower end of generic Yamaha home keyboards of this size/style.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the model number/label on the back or front panel.
Video demonstrating all keys and key buttons/functions working, with audio.
Photo of the power adapter with its label (voltage/model).
Close-up photos of the full key bed and casing for scratches, cracks, or heat damage.
response.reason: Seller's verbal reassurance does not substitute for photographic or video proof; all functional claims remain unverified and the item must still be priced at worst case pending the listed proof.
